summary: gyomu-schema provides canonical data models, validation rules, and schemas for the Gyomu ecosystem, focusing on Python code analysis structures, structured documents and translation strategies, domain error handling, and knowledge management definitions.
responsibilities: Define canonical data schemas and validation models for the Gyomu ecosystem.
Model Python code structures and AST components for static analysis and transformation tasks.
Provide structured document definitions and translation configuration models.
Establish standardized error handling, recovery, and logging structures across application layers.

capabilities.name: Python Code Analysis Schemas
capabilities.description: Comprehensive data models for representing Python code structures, AST expressions, statements, types, and module analyses.

capabilities.name: Document and Translation Schemas
capabilities.description: Schemas, validation rules, and translation strategies for structured documents, sections, and content elements.

capabilities.name: Error Handling and Recovery Schemas
capabilities.description: Core domain-specific error handling classes, resolution strategies, and retry policies for application operations.

capabilities.name: Knowledge Management Schemas
capabilities.description: Schemas for representing developer-oriented operational knowledge, coding guidelines, roadmaps, and technical references.

capabilities.name: Utility and Serialization Framework
capabilities.description: Serialization, validation, execution timing, and asynchronous/synchronous outcome utilities.

design_decisions: Utilizes Pydantic data models extensively for runtime type validation, serialization, and schema definition.
Organizes schemas hierarchically by domain (Python structures, documents, errors, knowledge, and system configurations).
Provides robust error handling and recovery abstractions with explicit retry and fallback strategies.
usage_guidance: Import schema models and validation tools directly from the appropriate domain submodules (e.g., Python AST models, document structures, or error definitions).
Utilize provided serialization and conversion utilities to validate and map data against Pydantic model definitions.
